brief_summary: Hero art for the guides-pillar switch actuation/bottom-out weight buying guide. Adapts bearings.md's guide default (annotated keycap row) per the brief's explicit subject mapping to the article's own heroImageAlt: five switch stems in a row, each rising out of a coiled spring, the springs drawn with progressively denser coils and thicker wire-gauge stroke left to right to imply increasing spring weight. Each stem is paired with a small force-gauge dial above it, connected by a thin dashed lead; the dial's needle sweeps further clockwise and its coral focal dot grows larger with each successive (heavier) switch, reading the gauge as the weight progression. A left-to-right intensifying coral wash and a faint dashed progression guide behind the dial row reinforce the increasing-weight narrative without any invented numeric labels.
